parent_objective: design integration of four-wheel fault primitives into source collection and capability-separable evaluation
blocked_by: M1266 implements four-wheel fault primitives but does not integrate them into source mining
supersedes: direct source mining before integration guardrails are designed

public_gates: M1267 must preserve actor input contract
M1267 must not use private holdout
M1267 must design source integration before implementation
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add per-wheel/fault labels to actor inputs
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot
do not run source mining before source reconstruction and observation mapping are specified

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs how four-wheel fault primitives enter source collection while preserving human-view actor inputs
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: integration design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, source-positive, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if integration requires actor input expansion
stop if source snapshots cannot be reconstructed deterministically
stop if source acceptance thresholds are changed
fallback_plan: if direct source collector integration is too large, design a no-env source-shape smoke over fixed four-wheel snapshots
if observation mapping is ambiguous, write an observation-compatibility audit before implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1266 passes model primitive tests and routes to integration design

admission_evidence: M1266 expresses signed split-mu and brake-pull yaw moments
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next implementation manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: design defines observation mapping and metadata boundaries
design defines capability-separable source smoke acceptance
design defines comparison against M1259/M1262 source shape

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1267 designs source integration and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If integration design cannot preserve actor-input guardrails or deterministic source reconstruction, stop before implementation.
allowed_claims: no source-positive, recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A bounded integration design can route four-wheel fault primitives into source mining while keeping deployable actor observations clean.
success_criteria: design defines observation mapping from four-wheel state to human-view frame
design defines metadata boundaries for per-wheel/fault data
design pre-registers the next bounded implementation if admitted
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design requires per-wheel/fault labels in actor input
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or threshold relaxation occurs
decision_rule: M1267 passes if it designs deterministic four-wheel source integration with clean actor observations and unchanged accepted-source thresholds.
